questions: Have you had any new headache, or pain in or around your right eye?
Do you see double vision, especially when looking to the right?
Have you noticed any weakness, numbness, or clumsiness in your arms or legs?
Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
Have you had any recent head injury or fall?
Do you have a fever, stiff neck, or feel generally unwell?
Have you ever been diagnosed with cancer of any kind?
Do you have any facial pain, numbness, or tingling?
Have you noticed any drooping of your eyelids or facial weakness?
Do you have thyroid disease or thyroid eye problems?
Did you have strabismus (crossed eyes) or a lazy eye as a child?
Are you currently pregnant or have you recently given birth?
Have you had any recent viral illness or upper respiratory infection?
Have you noticed any change in your vision or blurriness?
Do you have any pain in your ear, jaw, or teeth?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Right Duane's retraction syndrome (Type 1) — congenital cranial dysinnervation disorder due to absence/hypoplasia of the abducens nerve (CN VI) with co-innervation of the right lateral rectus by a branch of the oculomotor nerve.
1. Chronic/old right abducens (CN VI) palsy with sensory adaptation and suppression
2. Ocular myasthenia gravis with isolated right lateral rectus weakness
3. Restrictive right medial rectus contracture (e.g., from prior orbital trauma or "tight" medial rectus syndrome)
